what: Stars are kanji; a constellation is a radical family and its figure is its radical, drawn through its commonest kanji in writing order; the rarer kanji are field stars round it. Places are in units (one unit = the usual distance between two stars) on a band unitsAround wide (it closes on itself: x wraps) and unitsHigh tall (y up, 0 = the horizon). stars[k] = [constellation, role (0 on the figure, 1 field), x, y, depth 0 near .. 1 far, brightness 0..1] for kanji k of sky-data. wordsOf[k] = the words (indices into sky-data words) that hold kanji k, the commonest first (N5 and N4, then N3, N2, N1, unlisted; faulty rows left out): when a star is touched its first words stand nearest and largest. readIn[w] = [kind of the reading of the word (on, kun, mixed, or a whole-word or written-for-sound kind), [[character, its listed reading (on in katakana, kun in dictionary form), on|kun|whole, the kana it covers in this word], ...]]: use it for the line that says what a word is made of (日本 にっぽん · 日 ニチ ＋ 本 ホン); where a piece is marked whole or the kind is not on, kun or mixed, say the word is read as a whole and name no sum. hide = word indices that are not words: never draw or count them. gloss = corrected glosses by word index. figure = the strokes of the radical, each a row of [x, y, kanji or -1 for a bare joint]: draw each row as one line through its points.

kanjiLine.what: kanjiLine.line[k] = [heard, listed, meaning] for kanji k of sky-data.json: what the line under a touched kanji prints (truth round, 2026-11-14; tools/truth/kanjiline.mjs). heard = the readings the kanji takes in its own words here (wordsOf, readIn), the most used first, at most four, joined with ・ (on in katakana, kun in hiragana, dictionary form). listed = "" or, only where heard is "" (no word here carries a reading of it), the one reading from the kanji table to print: its first on, else its first kun (lead's ruling 11-14: no padding). meaning = the meaning to print ("" = print none). The kanji rows of sky-data.json are not changed. (step 8, second round, 2026-11-14; tools/truth/kanjimeaning.mjs) meaning, after step 3: where the printed meaning was of odd form or none of its words carried it, it was read; it is today's, one or two of KANJIDIC2's English meanings of the kanji, or the cut meaning of its own one-kanji row (ledger/kanji-meaning.json).

familyTitles.what: familyTitles.rows[i] (i = the index of the constellation, as in constellations[i].i; its key is unchanged): the corrected parts of that family's title (truth round, 2026-11-14; tools/truth/titles.mjs). sign = what to write where the family's sign (fig or key) is written in its title: the modern form first, the old one in brackets; carry = the forms to name in "radical: N kanji carry …" in place of the label's; rd = the reading to print in place of the first dictionary readings. A field that is absent is printed as today.

sentSkip.what: sentSkip.rows = { word number: [sentence numbers of ../sky/sky-context.json] }: sentences left out of that word's list under the open word, because they read the written form with another reading than the one shown (truth round, 2026-11-14, and its second round, 2026-11-15: tools/truth/sentences.mjs, decisions in tools/truth/sentences-read.json)
